verdict.problems:
The seven reviewer problems are resolved, but two intro claims go beyond their sources and some years are inferred.

Checks 1 and 4 pass. The lint printed 0 matches and the em dash count is 0. Every body URL is in the frontmatter sources. I did not scan every body link against the source list one by one beyond reading the page.

Fixes confirmed against the sources:
- Collegetown leasing bullet (line 70): the 2022 Sun article says "The Student Agencies building was one of the first places to begin renting for the 2023-2024 school year in early September." It also names Urban Ithaca, Lambrou and Modern Living Rentals as agencies that "also began opening up their units for rent." A student says "started looking shortly after arriving here in August." The bullet matches.
- December 1 (line 90): the AAP page says "Spring transfer deadline: December 1" under Internal Transfer Applicants, for current Cornell students. It matches.
- April 15 (line 92): the admissions page says "All other required materials." It matches.
- Orientation (line 94): the orientation page says "Transfer Student Move-In: August 18, 2026" and "NSO: August 18-23, 2026." It matches.
- Jan 1 TCAT (line 46): the 2024 Sun article says "first-year students — including freshman and transfer students — who are given a free OmniRide bus pass." It matches.
- Nov 1 (line 44): the winter parking page says the city "enforces on-street odd-even parking rules from November 1-April 1 when snow removal is necessary." It matches.
- Dec 1 to Apr 1 Cornell overnight rules, "fall semester only," decisions "late April through June," and "within ten days of receiving your NetID" for transfers are all supported.

Problems remaining:
1. Line 29: "you are admitted after the Collegetown rush has picked over the year's apartments" is not supported. The Sun article only says agencies began renting in early September and students started looking in August. It says nothing about the rush finishing before April to June admission. This is an inference stated as fact. Same sentence: "you usually know no one to room with" is a stretch. The housing page says only that most students have no roommate before they apply.
2. Lines 29, 91, 92 and 93: "fall 2027," "March 15, 2027," "April 15, 2027" and "late April through June 2027" are not on the admissions page. I fetched it and it gives no year; it says only "fall semester only," March 15, April 15 and "late April through June." The years are inferred from today's date. The page also does not say "Transfer Common App" for March 15; it lists "Application; application fee or fee waiver" and a portfolio if required. The CSS Profile and FAFSA part rests on the aid page, which I did not re-fetch. The earlier review confirmed it.
3. Line 35: "the rules already in force if you arrive in January with a car" conflicts with the page's own point that external transfer is fall only. It also conflicts with the Nov 1 and Dec 1 dates. The reader-facing description is wrong for this reader. The same January framing appears in lines 34 and 38.
4. Line 68: the June 22 (2018) bullet turns one year's notice date from the 2018 Sun article into "expect your notice late spring to June." The Cornell housing page says confirmations begin in mid-June. The "late spring" part is unsupported.

I did not re-fetch the 2018 Sun article, the residential policy page, the C2C page or the permit page. Their bullets were confirmed in the earlier review.
